title: Provisioning job status
caption: `platform.provisioning_jobs.status` for every kind (provision, migrate, suspend, resume). One active job per tenant and kind (partial unique index).

states.label: queued
states.detail: Waiting for its gate (provision from M5: the paid Checkout) or its backoff (`scheduled_at`).

states.label: running
states.detail: Dispatched as `<jobId>-<attempt>` on ota-tenant-ops; lease `locked_until` 15 min. While the BullMQ message is still waiting or active (OTA worker stopped) the reconciler only extends the lease; `ops.alert` "stuck" after the second lease.

states.label: succeeded
states.detail: Post-steps done (provision) or the OTA worker answered.

states.label: failed
states.detail: Attempts exhausted or non-retryable; ops.alert e-mail. A retry creates a NEW job.

states.label: canceled
states.detail: Admin cancel (queued only), SUPERSEDED by a newer suspend/resume, or CHECKOUT_ABANDONED.

transitions.label: retryable failure, or lease ended with the message missing or failed: backoff 30 s × 2^attempt
superseded by a newer suspend or resume
provisioning.reconcile extends the lease (message still waiting/active)
